payoutRules: A natural blackjack pays {bj}, a normal win 1:1, a push returns the stake. The dealer stands on all 17s. A {decks}-deck shoe is freshly shuffled every round.
yourTurn: Your turn. Stake this round: {n} virtual coins.
doubleHint: First two cards only: an equal extra stake and one more card.
serverNote: The server keeps every card and validates each move. Reload the page? Your round will resume.
